description:
Solobeat is a one-person team from Yangon. I build practical web tools on NASA open data.

For Space Apps 2026 I'm working on Mee ("fire" in Burmese) for the MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge. Mee merges NASA's MODIS and VIIRS fire detections into one consistent record, shows when and where each township burns, compares this season with normal, and sends alerts when fire activity rises. I'm starting with Myanmar, where the dry-season haze comes back every year.
